exposure: Bachelor of Science in Midwifery (BScM) program at Lira University
outcome: Midwifery competencies in surgical obstetric and newborn care
cohort: The participants were 356 students enrolled in the BScM program from 2013-2018, and 32 graduates from January 2019 whose internship reports and interviews were reviewed.
finding: The Bachelor in Midwifery curriculum successfully incorporated critical competencies in surgical obstetric and newborn care, leading to high employment rates among graduates who reported positive maternal and newborn outcomes and the ability to practice advanced skills.
mod_finding: The BScM program equipped midwives with competencies to care for pre- and post-operative caesarean section patients or assist in a caesarean section.
